name: Expense & Mileage Log
tagline: Keep job expenses and kilometres on your phone, then download a CSV.
audience: Sole proprietors and small businesses that track spending and driving
before: Receipts live in a glove box and kilometres live in a notes app. At tax time you retype both.
after: Log an expense or a trip in a few fields. Download a CSV for your bookkeeper, and save a copy of the whole log so you can open it again later.
privacy_note: The list is kept in this browser. Clearing the site data, using a private or incognito window, or switching phones removes it. Save a copy of the whole log if you want a file you can open later.
built_with: One web page. The CSV is built in the browser.
